instantiate_single_site_uniform_mh: create a SingleSiteUniformMetropolisHastings instance to perform uniform Metropolis-Hastings inference on a probabilistic model
run_uniform_mh_inference: run single site uniform Metropolis-Hastings inference by calling sample on a SingleSiteUniformMetropolisHastings instance with queries and observations
propose_uniform_for_discrete: use SingleSiteUniformProposer to propose from a uniform Categorical distribution for discrete random variables
propose_uniform_for_bernoulli: use SingleSiteUniformProposer to propose from a uniform Bernoulli distribution for binary random variables
get_proposers_for_targets: call get_proposers on SingleSiteUniformMetropolisHastings to retrieve proposers for a set of target random variables
